title: Guest order access tokens are written to logs and error tracking
expected: Capability tokens never appear in logs or third-party telemetry; redaction covers tokens, cookies and contact fields.
actual: The guest order link token is part of the URL path (/api/direct-orders/link/:token, page /order/:token). The HTTP logger logs req.url for every request; logger redaction covers only the Authorization header and three password/card body fields (not Cookie, refresh tokens, OTP codes or email/phone). Sentry traces (20% sample) and frontend error events carry the URL with no beforeSend scrubbing.
impact: Anyone with log or Sentry access (staff, the log host, Sentry as processor) can open a guest's order: name, phone, email, address, payment receipts, and report payment on their behalf.
fix: Log a route template instead of the raw URL (req.route?.path or a regex that replaces /link/<token> with /link/:token); extend pino redact paths to req.headers.cookie, res.headers['set-cookie'], *.token, *.otpCode, *.access_token, *.email, *.phone; add Sentry beforeSend/beforeSendTransaction that strips tokens from URLs and breadcrumbs. Consider moving the token to a fragment or POST body for API calls.
